root_cause: The secondary diagonal in an NxN grid should be checked when the sum of indices `i` and `j` equals `N-1`, not `N+1`. The condition `if (x+y == N+1)` is incorrect, leading to logical errors.
suggestion:
Suggestion 1. Correct the off-by-one error in the diagonal check - Locate the line `if (x+y == N+1)` in the code.
- Modify the condition to `if (x+y == N-1)` instead.
- This change ensures the correct identification of the secondary diagonal in the grid, avoiding logical errors.
